note: The old tests handed the writer resolved variables; here the same memberships come from delivered code lists. SHARED: one membership (01 Participation, 02 Employment) delivered by SCB in 2000 and 2002 and by SOS in 2002 (the old test's scb and sos providers, two states each where SCB delivers it). CODES: the five memberships of the distinct-memberships test, one per year. CODELESS and TWIN: the old overlap test's pairs, reached by delivering the case-equivalent columns First and first in one edition under one reviewed partition: First's list beside first without one, and one list (01 Label) under two version labels. The SOS variable declares no classification, so it carries a warning this case does not claim.
fails_if: `_write_value_sets` (materialize.py) stores a value set per state or per provider instead of per membership, or `_value_set_hash` (db.py) or the value-code id drops the label or stops length-prefixing code and label (ab/c and a/bc share one set, or the build fails on the unique member hash); `column_state_overlaps` (resolved_catalog.py) stops attributing a code-less state beside a code-bearing one on a folded column (the writer's validation then aborts the diagnostic build), or counts one list under two version labels as distinct value sets (TWIN is withheld)
